standfirst: The Caenorhabditis-infecting nodaviruses — Le Blanc, Santeuil, Orsay and Melnik. The only nodaviruses with a programmed −1 ribosomal frameshift and a non-AUG start codon, and the only ones that encode neither B1 nor B2. Three overlapping products come out of one 2.3 kb region of RNA2.

modules.Le_Blanc_nodavirus: Four features. RNA1 carries a single CDS. RNA2 carries the capsid, which begins at an AAC codon with no AUG upstream of it; the capsid–delta fusion, made by a −1 frameshift at a slippery heptamer immediately before the capsid stop; and free delta, translated from its own AUG further downstream. The module is named for its most-sampled species — Le Blanc 49 genomes against Santeuil 44 — though Orsay virus, with four genomes, carries nearly all the literature.

gaps: B1 and B2 both return ABSENT and both are required to. PMID 21283608 searched the 3′ end of RNA1 for a +1 ORF with B2's properties and found none, and PMID 23468484 detected no silencing-suppressor activity for either Orsay protein proposed as one. Santeuil and Melnik RNA2 deposits are 5′-truncated — their contigs begin inside the capsid gene, so the proteins start at Lys rather than the verified Asn — and are excluded from the capsid collection rather than used to train its profile.
derived: CP-delta has no PSSM. It is a frameshift product, called from a curated nucleotide reference set in which one base is duplicated at the slip site. Building that set turned up a fact the literature leaves open: there are two slippery heptamers in this group, not one. Orsay and Le Blanc carry GTCAAAC in 26 of 26 genomes and Santeuil and Melnik carry GGAAAAC in 24 of 24, measured as the 7 nucleotides immediately 5′ of the capsid stop. Built on the published Orsay heptamer alone the set covered two species; with both it covers all four, at 47 references, each validated by reproducing its own deposited fusion protein byte-for-byte.

why.CP: Initiated at a codon that is not AUG. The mature Orsay capsid N-terminus was Edman-sequenced as NKNNT, corresponding to the AAC codon at RNA2 nucleotides 89–91, with no AUG 5′ of it in the segment (PMID 24503084); verified directly on HM030971. check_met_start.py reports this feature in 100% of its members, and that report is the documented biology rather than a defect.
